thread:
Tessa (Finance): Quick request 1: SilverLine Healthcare (EMEA reseller) asked for custom terms for a 6-month pilot tied to Dedicated capacity: 18% reserved-capacity discount + EUR10k onboarding credit, invoice Net60, and VAT passthrough. Need deal-desk approval, CFO signoff for extended terms, and legal addendum. Details below.

Liam (Sales): Context: reseller will commit to a small Dedicated pool for pilot hospitals in IT/FR. Expected usage ~200k tokens/mo, rising to 700k. They say the onboarding credit covers engineering integration and certification. No long-term contract yet 1; goal is to convert to Dedicated commitment after pilot.

Anya (RevOps): Ops checks: (1) cap onboarding credit to EUR10k total, (2) discount applies only to Dedicated pool usage billed to reseller master account, (3) clawback if reseller terminates mapped end-customer within 120 days prorated, (4) need Zuora ticket for `dedicated_reserve_discount` and `onboard_credit` charge types + holdback rule.

Mark (Legal): I can draft a slim addendum. Must include definition of "reserved-capacity discount" (applied to Dedicated unit charges), discount floor, onboarding credit redemption rules, clawback formula, VAT representation, and audit rights. Recommend explicit success metric for conversion if they want guaranteed roll to Dedicated.

Ethan (CFO): Net60 impacts DSO. Conditional approval only. Require: (A) 50% of onboarding credit held as AR holdback until month 3, (B) reseller credit check + trade refs, (C) cap discount to EUR equivalent of 18% but not exceeding EUR25k total lifetime. Also need FX treatment: invoice in EUR preferred.

Tessa (Finance): Accounting guidance: treat onboarding credit as deferred contra-revenue amortized across pilot months. Discount recorded as reduction in service revenue for billed Dedicated units. RevOps please confirm Zuora can enforce the cap + holdback.

Anya (RevOps): Can do. I'll open ticket ZOA-11111 to create `dedicated_reserve_discount` with a monthly cap and `onboard_credit` with a 50% holdback until month 3. Will also add mapping so credits only apply to the reseller master account. Linking to deal SL-901.

Liam (Sales): SilverLine supplied VAT ID and two trade refs via email. They'll accept EUR invoices. I'll route addendum to reseller after Legal drafts. ETA 48h for signed doc.

Mark (Legal): Draft addendum uploaded to deal SL-901. Key terms in plain text:```
- 18% reserved-capacity discount on Dedicated unit charges (max EUR25k total)
- Onboarding credit EUR10,000 applied as credit memos, 50% held until month 3
- Pilot period: 2026-09-15 to 2027-03-14 (6 months)
- Clawback: credits repayable if reseller-caused termination within 120 days, prorated formula included
- Reseller reps: valid VAT ID, OSS proof if requesting 0% VAT invoice; audit rights 12 months
```

Tessa (Finance): Approve in principle. Final sign-off contingent on: signed addendum, ZOA-11111 live with holdback, credit check completed. I'll post final approval here once RevOps and Legal confirm execution.

Anya (RevOps): ZOA-11111 created and assigned to billing-team. Ticket includes holdback, cap, and account mapping.

billing-bot: ZOA-11111 linked to SL-901: `dedicated_reserve_discount` + `onboard_credit` created; default 50% holdback applied.

pricing-bot: Note added to deal SL-901: "SilverLine pilot: 18% Dedicated discount (cap EUR25k), onboarding credit EUR10k with 50% holdback, Net60, VAT passthrough pending OSS docs."

Liam (Sales): Sending addendum to SilverLine now. Will post signed confirmation and trade-ref screenshots here. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Ethan (CFO): Conditional approval recorded. Final approval after: signed addendum, ZOA-11111 implemented, satisfactory credit check. If any fail revert to Net30 and remove onboarding credit.

Tessa (Finance): Marking thread for monthly approval tracker. Please keep updates contained to this thread only.
